rule: The 50 most-starred GitHub repositories (search of all public repositories with over 40,000 stars, read October 27, 2026) that would pass r/opensource's other new requirements: software (a program, library, framework, app or tool you install or run, not a list, book, course, tutorial, guide, template or prompt collection), an OSI-approved license for the whole repository, at least a year old (created before October 27, 2025), maintained (a commit in the past year), and three or more contributors. Projects built for AI are kept and marked, since the rule's 'intended for AI' clause excludes them on its own.

ai.obra/superpowers: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
ai.NousResearch/hermes-agent: The agent that grows with you
ai.tensorflow/tensorflow: An Open Source Machine Learning Framework for Everyone
ai.firecrawl/firecrawl: Supercharge your AI agents with data from the web and beyond.
ai.microsoft/markitdown: Python tool for converting files and office documents to Markdown.
ai.ollama/ollama: Get up and running with Kimi, GLM, MiniMax, DeepSeek, gpt-oss, Qwen, Gemma and other models.
ai.huggingface/transformers: Transformers: the model-definition framework for state-of-the-art machine learning models
ai.msitarzewski/agency-agents: A complete AI agency at your fingertips
ai.langflow-ai/langflow: Langflow is a powerful tool for building and deploying AI-powered agents and workflows.
ai.farion1231/cc-switch: A cross-platform desktop All-in-One assistant for Claude Code, Codex, ...
ai.Comfy-Org/ComfyUI: The most powerful and modular diffusion model GUI, api and backend
ai.github/spec-kit: Toolkit to help you get started with SDD (spec-driven development with AI coding agents)
ai.harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo: Generate HD short videos from a topic with one click using large AI models.
ai.openai/codex: Lightweight coding agent that runs in your terminal
ai.browser-use/browser-use: Open-source Python library for AI browser agents
ai.earendil-works/pi: AI agent toolkit: unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI, coding agent CLI
ai.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: TradingAgents: Multi-Agents LLM Financial Trading Framework
ai.openai/whisper: Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision
ai.google-gemini/gemini-cli: An open-source AI agent that brings the power of Gemini directly into your terminal.
ai.pytorch/pytorch: Tensors and Dynamic neural networks in Python with strong GPU acceleration

aiNotes.microsoft/markitdown: Its README says it converts documents to Markdown 'for use with LLMs and related text analysis pipelines' and it ships an MCP server, so it is counted as built for AI.
aiNotes.obra/superpowers: A plugin of skills, commands and hooks that coding agents install and run, so it is counted as software (built for AI).
aiNotes.msitarzewski/agency-agents: Agent definitions with an installer for Claude Code and other agent tools, so it is counted as software (built for AI).

leftOut.multica-ai/andrej-karpathy-skills: under a year old (created January 27, 2026), and no license
leftOut.vuejs/vue: not maintained (Vue 2, end of life; no commit since October 10, 2024)
leftOut.n8n-io/n8n: not under an OSI license (Sustainable Use License)
leftOut.DigitalPlatDev/FreeDomain: documents for a free domain service, no software
leftOut.Significant-Gravitas/AutoGPT: not under an OSI license as a whole (its platform is under the Polyform Shield license)
leftOut.anthropics/skills: no open-source license for the repository as a whole
leftOut.f/prompts.chat: a prompt collection, with no single OSI license detected
leftOut.langgenius/dify: not under an OSI license (Apache 2.0 with added conditions)
leftOut.open-webui/open-webui: not under an OSI license (Open WebUI License, with a branding clause)
leftOut.VoltAgent/awesome-design-md: a collection, under a year old
leftOut.react/create-react-app: not maintained (deprecated; no commit since February 15, 2025)
leftOut.Stirling-Tools/Stirling-PDF: not under an OSI license as a whole (several directories are under proprietary licenses)
